description: Permit history for one property, looked up by street address (house number and street name, e.g. '123 Main St'). Optional city, state and ZIP narrow the match when the same street address exists in several places. Returns a property profile (permit timeline, category breakdown, contractors) and up to 25 permit records per page, newest first; `has_more` says whether the next page has more. Covers all permit categories. When the connected account covers a limited date range, the profile and records cover only that range, `account_window_from` is set, and `_notes` says so: the result is then not the property's full permit history. Results carry no property owner name, owner mailing address or permit applicant name fields.

address.description: Street address with house number, e.g. '123 Main St' (min 3 characters)

city.description: Optional city, to tell identical street addresses apart

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

name: get_property_history
title: Property permit history
